title: 26 贺州坊市27 冲突
content_zh:
“你到底是谁？“那个凝元初期的男子终于忍不住问了一句。
“你没资格知道。“洛豪淡淡的回了一句，挥动手中的黑蛛刀，浮沉刀轰然而下，一道大约十丈长的刀幕夹杂着洛豪的真火，轰向了五人。想要杀了他并且还想抢夺他的东西，那就做好被他反杀的觉悟吧。
浮沉刀的刀幕气势瞬间锁定了五人所在空间，速度非常的快，让五人根本来不及躲避，因为等到五人反应过来之时，他们也已经躲不开了，于是五人全力的挥动了手中的灵器，想要将洛豪的浮沉刀给挡下。
轰轰轰，五人根本挡不住洛豪的浮沉刀而被击飞出去，就连他们拿在手中的灵器也被洛豪的浮沉刀给击飞了出去，就像五个断了线的风筝一般，五人倒飞出去的瞬间，在地面上砸出了五个不同大小的坑洞，然后五人全身狼狈的站了起来，看着洛豪的眼神十分的惊恐，终于五人再也忍不住，喷出了几道血箭。
浮沉刀的刀幕将五人击飞出去还并没有扩散完，直到将不远处的一棵大树给砍到了之后，浮沉刀的刀幕才消散而去。
洛豪慢慢的走到了五人的面前，双目冰冷如同冬天里的寒冰一样照在了五人身上，五人顿时吓得瑟瑟发抖。为首的凝元初期的修士更是瞬间跪了下来，向洛豪求饶，“这位前辈饶命，我再也不敢了，求前辈饶过我一次。“
剩余的四个人看到自己的老大都跪地求饶了，也都一致的跪了下来，扑通扑通的磕头声不停的响起，在这寂静的森林中格外刺耳。
洛豪的眼里涌出一股杀机，有些不屑的开口，“五个垃圾败类，只知道欺凌弱小，如果今天不是我，而是其他挡不住你们的修士，恐怕早就被你们杀了吧！“
五人听到洛豪话，更是颤栗不堪，磕头声更加的大了。洛豪听得有些不耐烦，挥了挥手，“如果你们保证以后不再抢夺并且杀害修士，我就饶了你们一命。否则我不介意现在就送你们去西天。“
五人听到洛豪的话心里一喜，连连保证，“多谢前辈，我们记住了，以后绝对不会敢再犯事了。“
“那就快滚吧！“洛豪挥了挥手。
“是，前辈。“五人迅速的站了起来，然后齐齐往一个方向逃走了。
随后，洛豪准备绕过他们前往鸿宇仙祖说的那个修真坊市，忽然想起来自己还不知道应该如何从这里出去，于是叫住了正要逃走的五人，“喂，你们知道怎么出去这个贺山森林吗?“
那个凝元初期的修士顿时点了点头，“前辈跟我们来，我们知道如何出去。“话音刚落，这个修士的眼里闪过一丝阴毒之色，但很快就恢复了原状，洛豪自然是注意到了他的神色，不过洛豪却不动声色，跟着他们往前面走去。洛豪自信不管这五人有什么阴谋诡计，他都不怕。
跟着五杀盗走了几个时辰的路，果然走出了贺山森林，出了贺山森林，前方出现一个石碑，石碑上写着:贺州坊市。洛豪总算明白过来，终于来到了贺州坊市入口，洛豪也想在贺州坊市交易一些东西，所以对五杀盗表达了感激，“你们还不错，这次就饶了你们，希望你们好自为之。“说完洛豪便身形一闪，冲进了贺州坊市。
等到洛豪消失之后，五杀盗的老三才恨恨的开口，“老大，此人实力如此强劲，我们要如何报仇雪恨?“
那个凝元初期的修士，也就是五杀盗的老大一脸的狰狞，只见他挥了挥手，一只飞行灵兽忽然出现在了他的眼前，然后他将一个玉简绑在了飞行灵兽的脚上，等到飞行灵兽飞走之后，他才悠悠的开口，“不用着急，我已经通知了我在贺州坊市里的靠山贺长老，他是一位成丹初期的高手，贺长老会为我们抓住他的，我们只需要耐心等待即可。“
五杀盗之所以能够逃出成丹期高手的围捕，就是因为五杀盗有贺长老罩着，虽然贺长老无法阻拦来围攻五杀盗的成丹期高手，但是贺长老却可以通知五杀盗逃走，毕竟贺长老是贺州坊市的高层之一，而且贺州坊市的高层根本就不知道他们与贺长老的关系。
贺州坊市虽然有各方势力，但为了方便管理，还是有三大成丹期长老坐镇，第一位据说比较神秘莫测，实力为成丹圆满，几乎没有出现在贺州坊市过，听人传闻他性格比较孤僻高傲，一般人根本无法见到他。
第二位是一个道姑，传闻她美貌非凡，但是这个道姑脾气也十分的不好，实力在成丹中期，就算是成丹中期，一般的成丹后期也不敢招惹她，因为她有一个非常厉害的拂尘，据说这个拂尘还杀过成丹后期的高手，所以根本就没有人敢招惹这个道姑。

不过她和第一位成丹圆满的长老关系却不错，当然这也是传下来的，然后最后一位就是五杀盗的靠山贺长老了。由于另外两位性格都比较极端，不愿意处理事情，所以他们基本都在修炼，而贺州坊市内大大小小的事情都落到了贺长老身上，不过贺长老显然也比较乐意这样，因为这就表明他才是贺州坊市的实际掌控者。
洛豪当然不知道自己被五杀盗给算计了，不过就算知道了洛豪也并没有放在心上，因为洛豪在进入了贺州坊市之后，就将自己易容成一个中年大汉的样子，当然洛豪并没有将黑蛛刀放进混沌书中。
因为他也不确定贺州坊市是否真的有厉害的大能，连鸿宇仙祖都可以看出来他有混沌书，那他更要小心了，所以他将混沌书给隐匿在了神识当中，只要没有人像鸿宇仙祖一样侵入他的神识，那就不可能会发现他的混沌书。
或许是因为洛豪的身上带着一股凌厉的气息，也就没有许多人敢靠近洛豪，只要洛豪一经过，就纷纷都让开。街边上到处都是交易灵草或者灵兽内丹的小摊贩，洛豪甚至还看到了有几处卖丹药的地方。只不过看到上面的价格，洛豪也是暗自皱眉，因为实在是太贵了。
一颗下品聚真丹就要一百株真心草，更不要说凝元丹，回血丹这些了，洛豪只是看了一眼，就离开了，走了大概一刻钟，洛豪终于来到了一家商楼前，商楼的大门顶上四个大字格外的引人注目——贺州商楼，下面还有一行小字介绍，说是贺州坊市的第一商楼，任何灵草，灵器，丹药都有。
洛豪思索了片刻，便走了进去，因为洛豪想要买一个炼丹炉，看了那些丹药的价格之后，洛豪觉得还不如自己买一个炼丹炉先暂时用着，这样他也就不用将灵草当丹药吃了，洛豪一走进贺州商楼，一个长相清秀的结真初期实力的女修便带着满脸的笑容迎了上来，“这位客官想要点什么呢?“
“这里有没有炼丹炉？“洛豪略微犹豫了一下便问出了口。
贺州商楼里有不少的修士，一听到洛豪的话，都带着惊异的眼光看向了洛豪，就是那个接待的女修也是有些吃惊的看着洛豪。洛豪自然不知道一个炼丹炉所代表的含义是什么，见此情景，有些皱了皱眉，“到底有没有？“
那个结真初期的女修见洛豪有发怒的征兆，连忙点了点头，“不好意思客官，炼丹炉是有的，请跟我来。“说完，这个女修便朝二楼走去，洛豪见状也跟了上去。
洛豪和那个女修上了二楼之后，一楼的修士便议论纷纷，洛豪的确阅历太浅了，不知道炼丹炉所代表的含义，因为购买炼丹炉那就表示你会炼丹，放眼整个贺州坊市，炼丹师也是屈指可数，这也表明炼丹师的地位非常的尊贵。
哪怕只是一品炼丹师在这贺州坊市也算比较尊贵的存在了，这也是为什么贺州商楼外面那些卖丹药的丹药阁将丹药卖的非常贵的原因，但就算是卖的非常贵，也依然会有很多修士前往买丹，因为贺州坊市的炼丹师比较少，物以稀为贵，这样一来，炼丹师在贺州坊市就比较尊贵了。
所以洛豪一提出炼丹炉这三个字就明确表明了他自己是一个炼丹师，先不说洛豪是几品炼丹师，单单就洛豪看起来也不超过五十岁的年龄也足以让他们惊异一番了，因为炼丹师一般都是德高望重的老前辈了。很快的，贺州商楼来了一名炼丹师要买炼丹炉的消息就被传了出去。
一处洞府门前，一只飞行灵兽停下，一个成丹初期实力有着些许胡子的差不多五十岁的瘦小老头将飞行灵兽上的玉简拿下，然后快速的浏览了一遍，越看神情就越来越阴沉，当看完了玉简，他的神色更是暴怒到了极点，只不过强行忍住了，他就是五杀盗的靠山——贺长老。
一个结真初期的男修走进了贺长老的洞府，向贺长老恭敬的鞠了一躬，“贺长老，外面传言贺州商楼来了一位炼丹师。您看，此事应该如何处理?“
“是真的吗？“贺长老十分惊喜的问他，快，准备一下，咱们去贺州商楼，说完贺长老便身形一闪，往贺州商楼奔去。好不容易来了一个炼丹师，贺长老自然要将他收为麾下，甚至连五杀盗的事情都放在了一边。
有了炼丹师，那他何愁不能提升实力，只要等他成为了成丹圆满实力，那个老巫婆和她相好也得客客气气的对他说话，要不是因为他实力不济，早就对那老巫婆和她老相好翻脸了。那两人仗着实力比他高，没少给他摆脸色看，别看表面上他是贺州坊市的掌控者，但实际上那两人的意见他也不敢拒绝。
这次来了一个炼丹师，那么好的机遇，他自然不会放弃，这就是贺长老现在唯一的想法。
content_en:
"Who are you?" The man in the early stage of Yuan Condensation finally couldn't help but ask.
"You are not qualified to know." Luo Hao replied lightly, waving the black spider knife in his hand, the floating knife came down with a bang, and a sword curtain about ten feet long was mixed with Luo Hao's real fire, and hit the five people. If you want to kill him and snatch his things, be prepared to be killed in return.
The momentum of the sword curtain of the floating knife instantly locked the space where the five people were. It was so fast that the five people had no time to dodge, because by the time the five people reacted, they could no longer dodge, so the five people waved the spiritual weapons in their hands with all their strength, trying to block Luo Hao's floating knife.
Boom boom boom, the five people were unable to block Luo Hao's floating knife and were knocked away. Even the spiritual weapons they were holding were knocked away by Luo Hao's floating knife, like five kites with broken strings. The moment the five people flew out, five holes of different sizes were made on the ground. Then the five people stood up in a panic. Looking at Luo Hao's eyes, they were very frightened. Finally, the five people could not bear it anymore and sprayed out several blood arrows.
The sword curtain of the Floating and Sinking Sword knocked the five people away and did not spread out until it chopped down a big tree not far away.
Luo Hao slowly walked up to the five people, his eyes as cold as ice in winter shone on the five people, and the five people suddenly shivered with fear. The leader, a monk in the early stage of Ning Yuan, immediately knelt down and begged Luo Hao for mercy, "Senior, please spare my life. I don't dare to do it anymore. I beg senior to spare me once."
The remaining four people saw their boss kneeling down to beg for mercy, and they all knelt down in unison. The sound of thumping and kowtowing kept ringing out, which was particularly harsh in the silent forest.
Luo Hao's eyes welled up with murderous intent, and he spoke with some disdain, "Five trash scum, they only know how to bully the weak. If it weren't me today, but other monks who couldn't stop you, I'm afraid you would have killed them long ago!"
When the five people heard Luo Hao's words, they trembled even more and kowtowed louder. Luo Hao felt impatient and waved his hand, "If you promise not to rob or kill monks in the future, I will spare your lives. Otherwise, I don't mind sending you to the West now."
The five of them felt happy when they heard Luo Hao's words and repeatedly promised, "Thank you, senior, we will remember it and we will never dare to commit any crime again in the future."
"Then get out of here!" Luo Hao waved his hand.
"Yes, senior." The five people stood up quickly, and then all ran away in one direction.
Later, Luo Hao was about to bypass them and go to the Xiuzhenfang City that Hongyu Immortal Ancestor mentioned. Suddenly he remembered that he still didn't know how to get out of here, so he stopped the five people who were about to escape, "Hey, do you know how to get out of this Heshan Forest?"
The monk who was in the early stage of Yuan Condensation immediately nodded, "Senior, come with us, we know how to get out." As soon as he finished speaking, a sinister look flashed in the monk's eyes, but he quickly returned to his original state. Luo Hao naturally noticed his expression, but Luo Hao remained calm and followed them forward. Luo Hao is confident that no matter what conspiracies these five people have, he is not afraid.
After following Wusha Stealing the Road for several hours, we finally walked out of Heshan Forest. After exiting Heshan Forest, a stone tablet appeared in front of us. On the stone tablet it was written: Hezhoufang City. Luo Hao finally understood and finally came to the entrance of Hezhoufang City. Luo Hao also wanted to trade some things in Hezhoufang City, so he expressed his gratitude to the Wusha Thief, "You are not bad. I will spare you this time. I hope you will do well." After speaking, Luo Hao flashed and rushed into Hezhoufang City.
After Luo Hao disappeared, the third son of the Five Killers said bitterly, "Boss, this person is so powerful, how can we avenge him?"
That Ning YuanchuThe early monk, the boss of the Five Killing Thieves, had a ferocious look on his face. He waved his hand, and a flying spirit beast suddenly appeared in front of him. Then he tied a jade slip to the flying spirit beast's foot, and waited until the flying spirit beast flew away. Finally, he said leisurely, "Don't worry, I have already informed my backer in Hezhoufang City, Elder He. He is a master in the early stages of becoming an elixir. Elder He will catch him for us. We just need to wait patiently."
The reason why the Five Kills Thieves were able to escape from being rounded up by the masters of the adult stage was because the Five Kills Thieves were protected by Elder He. Although Elder He could not stop the masters of the Adult Stage who came to besiege the Five Kills Thieves, Elder He could notify the Five Kills Thieves to escape. After all, Elder He was one of the top leaders of Hezhoufang City, and the top brass of Hezhoufang City did not know their relationship with Elder He at all.
Although there are various forces in Hezhoufang City, in order to facilitate management, there are still three Chengdan-stage elders sitting in charge. The first one is said to be more mysterious and unpredictable. His strength is Chengdan Perfect. He has almost never appeared in Hezhoufang City. It is said that he has a relatively withdrawn and arrogant personality, and ordinary people cannot see him at all.
The second one is a Taoist nun. It is said that she is very beautiful, but this Taoist nun also has a very bad temper. Her strength is in the middle stage of becoming an elixir. Even in the middle stage of becoming an elixir, ordinary people in the late stage of becoming an elixir would not dare to provoke her because she has a very powerful whisk. It is said that this whisk has killed masters in the late stage of becoming an elixir, so no one dares to provoke this Taoist nun.
However, she has a good relationship with the first elder who achieved Perfection. Of course, this is also passed down, and the last one is Elder He, the backer of the Five Killing Thieves. Since the other two have extreme personalities and are unwilling to deal with things, they are basically practicing, and all the big and small things in Hezhoufang City fall on Elder He, but Elder He is obviously more happy with this, because it shows that he is the actual controller of Hezhoufang City.
Of course Luo Hao didn't know that he was being plotted by the Five Killers, but even if he knew, Luo Hao didn't take it to heart, because after Luo Hao entered Hezhoufang City, he disguised himself as a middle-aged man. Of course, Luo Hao did not put the Black Spider Sword into the Book of Chaos.
Because he was not sure whether Hezhoufang City really had powerful powers. Even Immortal Hongyu could tell that he had the Book of Chaos, so he had to be even more careful, so he hid the Book of Chaos in his consciousness. As long as no one invaded his consciousness like Immortal Hongyu, it would be impossible to discover his Book of Chaos.
Perhaps because Luo Hao had a sharp aura about him, not many people dared to approach Luo Hao. As soon as Luo Hao passed by, they all got out of the way. The streets were full of vendors selling spiritual herbs or spiritual beast inner elixirs. Luo Hao even saw a few places selling elixirs. But when he saw the price above, Luo Hao also frowned secretly, because it was too expensive.
One low-grade Zhenzhen Pill requires a hundred True Heart Grasses, not to mention Yuan Ning Dan and Blood Recovery Pill. Luo Hao just glanced at it and left. After walking for about a quarter of an hour, Luo Hao finally came to a commercial building. The four big characters on the top of the door of the commercial building were particularly eye-catching - Hezhou Commercial Building. There was also a line of small characters below to introduce it, saying that it was the number one commercial building in Hezhou Fang City. It had all kinds of spiritual herbs, spiritual weapons, and elixirs.
Luo Hao thought for a moment and then walked in, because Luo Hao wanted to buy an alchemy furnace. After looking at the prices of the elixirs, Luo Hao thought it would be better to buy an alchemy furnace and use it temporarily, so that he would not have to eat the spiritual herbs as elixirs. As soon as Luo Hao walked into the Hezhou Commercial Building, a pretty-looking female cultivator with early stage strength came up to him with a smile on her face, "What does this guest want to order?"
"Is there an alchemy furnace here?" Luo Hao hesitated for a moment before asking.
There are many repairmen in Hezhou commercial buildingsWhen the scholars heard Luo Hao's words, they all looked at Luo Hao with surprise. Even the female nun who received him also looked at Luo Hao in surprise. Luo Hao naturally didn't know what an alchemy furnace meant. Seeing this scene, he frowned a little, "Is there one?"
Seeing that Luo Hao was showing signs of anger, the female cultivator in the early stage of Jie Zhen nodded quickly and said, "Excuse me, sir, but there is an alchemy furnace. Please come with me." After saying that, the female cultivator walked towards the second floor, and Luo Hao followed after seeing this.
After Luo Hao and the female cultivator went up to the second floor, the monks on the first floor started talking about it. Luo Hao was indeed too inexperienced and did not know what the alchemy furnace meant, because buying an alchemy furnace means that you can make alchemy. Looking at the entire Hezhou Fang City, there are only a handful of alchemists, which also shows that the status of alchemists is very noble.
Even a first-grade alchemist is considered a relatively noble existence in Hezhoufang City. This is why the elixir pavilions outside Hezhou Commercial Buildings sell elixirs very expensively. But even if they are sold very expensively, many monks will still go to buy elixirs, because there are relatively few alchemists in Hezhoufang City, and things are rare. In this way, alchemists are more noble in Hezhoufang City.
So when Luo Hao mentioned the words "Alchemy Furnace", it was clear that he was an alchemist. Not to mention what level of alchemist Luo Hao was, just the fact that Luo Hao didn't look more than fifty years old was enough to surprise them, because alchemists are generally respected seniors. Soon, the news spread that an alchemist came to Hezhou Shanglou to buy an alchemy furnace.
In front of a cave door, a flying spirit beast stopped. A thin old man of about fifty years old with some beard who was in the early stage of becoming a pill took off the jade slip from the flying spirit beast, and then quickly browsed it. His expression became more and more gloomy as he read the jade slip. When he finished reading the jade slip, his expression became even more furious, but he held it back forcibly. He was the backer of the Five Killing Thieves - Elder He.
A male cultivator in the early stage of Jie Zhen walked into Elder He's cave and bowed respectfully to Elder He, "Elder He, there are rumors that an alchemist has come to Hezhou Shanglou. Do you think how should this matter be handled?"
"Is it true?" Elder He asked him in great surprise, "Quick, get ready, let's go to Hezhou Commercial Building." After saying this, Elder He flashed and ran towards Hezhou Commercial Building. After finally finding an alchemist, Elder He naturally wanted to take him under his command, and even put aside the matter of the Five Killing Thieves.
With the alchemy master, there's no need for him to improve his strength. As long as he reaches the full strength of Cheng Dan, the old witch and her old sweetheart will have to speak politely to him. If it weren't for his lack of strength, he would have fallen out with the old witch and her old sweetheart. Those two people were superior to him because of their strength, and they kept showing off to him. Although he seemed to be the controller of Hezhoufang City, in fact he did not dare to refuse the opinions of those two people.
This time an alchemist came. With such a good opportunity, he would naturally not give up. This was Elder He's only thought now.
